bar: Match the visual craft of bruno-simon.com's live Three.js scene (lighting, materials, composition — progress/bar/bruno-simon.png) AND the absurd-comedy feel of Goat Simulator 3 (progress/bar/goatsim1.jpg), judged by a cold critic via blind A/B plus the numeric gates below.

pieces.name: core-loop
pieces.gate: sweet-shot bucket hit rate >= 90% over 10 launches; sweetStrain solver converges (|signed distance at rim| < 0.1m)

pieces.name: scene-visuals
pieces.gate: cold-critic blind A/B vs bar images: craft score >= 7/10

metrics.abMethod: fresh-context cold critic (vision delegate timed out twice — pixel-harness critic, no repo context), analyze.mjs + probe_craft.mjs on game vs bar

pieces.name: hud-legibility
pieces.gate: 0 clipped HUD elements in capture; score/combo/gauge/equip all fully in-frame

pieces.name: juice-fx

history.note: Round 1 = baseline capture. Blender models (11 GLB) + Three.js game + gauntlet harness committed; core loop calibrated (sweetStrain solver, 10/10 hits); visuals 5/10 vs bar. Biggest gap: lighting/shading flatness.

Closed the regressed core-loop win: uncommitted bloom/lighting work dropped SwiftShader to ~9fps; the 50ms dt cap ran the whole sim (incl. the strain gauge) in slow-motion and key-up released from the last physics step up to a full frame late, so real-time releases hit strain 0.17-0.44 vs sweet 0.30 and landed ~1.3m short (0/10). Fixed with a 120Hz fixed-timestep accumulator, strain computed from the DOM key-event timestamp (frame-rate independent, HUD and physics now agree exactly), a flatter launch curve 3.5+9s -> 5.31+1.8s so the HUD's +-0.11 sweet band is the band that actually lands (perfect zone still tight at +-0.06), and quarter-res bloom. Sweet 10/10 all PERFECT (score 13250), hud-legibility also cleared 3 -> 0 clips, performance gate held (1.21ms). scene-visuals re-scored 4/10 by a pixel-measured cold critic (vision critic timed out); its named gap is now the next target: bright washed-out field vs the bar's dense dark diorama (meanLum 180 vs 56, structureRatio 16% vs 99%).

Closed the scene-visuals gap with a dusk-diorama rework: dark indigo->amber sky dome, low warm sun (long shadows) + cool fill + dim hemisphere, dense dusk fog (20-42m), dark olive-moss forest floor with shadow clumps, tree ring pulled in and enlarged + retinted olive-brown, inner shrub/boulder rings clearing the flight corridor, worn dirt path, dusk clouds + low moon, a warm porch PointLight focal glow on the outhouse door, ACES exposure 1.08->0.65, bloom 0.3->0.55, a teal-shadow/warm-highlight saturation+color-grade ShaderPass, and a dolly-in camera framing the outhouse as the focal subject. Cold-critic blind A/B (fresh context, analyze.mjs pixel evidence): 4/10 -> 7/10 (gate >=7), and the final critic ruled the GAME frame more polished than the bar on the decisive trait — warm-lit focal subject isolated in true-black negative space (darkPct 0.437 vs bar 0.0, center/ring contrast 2.51 vs 1.76; meanLum 44.9 vs 55.8, meanSat 62.7 vs 64). All win pieces re-measured, no regressions: core-loop sweet 10/10 + 10 perfects, hud-legibility 0 clips, performance mean 1.26ms/frame. Harness untouched. Next gap named by the final critic: focal subject reads as a chunky mass — brownRatio 0.26; falsifiable close: brownRatio < 0.12 while darkPct > 0.40 and center/ring stays > 2.5.

Closed the round-3 critic gap (focal outhouse read as a chunky warm-brown mass): green-margined moss albedo (base #1f3a14, clumps/dirt kept g>=r), outhouse wood green-biased darkened + desaturated (silhouette + warm porch stroke, not umber blob), trunk/foliage multipliers re-tuned so lit pixels keep a green margin, dry bushes + worn path neutralized from warm brown to olive-grey. Sun 3.6->1.05 with a peach hue (#ffc98a, r/g no longer flips lit moss to r>g); brightness carried by COOL fill 1.1->1.8 + hemisphere ambient 0.75->2.4 (cool ground tint) + exposure 0.65->1.0 so shadowed moss reads dark green, not crushed black; bloom 0.55->0.42 / threshold 0.72->0.8 to kill the clipped porch halo; grade uSat 1.75->2.05 to recover meanSat (62.7->59.7, bar 64). Cold pixel-harness critic (fresh context, no repo files; vision delegate timed out twice on this provider): brownRatio 0.262 -> 0.117 (< 0.12 gate) with centerRingContrast 4.05 -> 3.16 (> 2.5), darkPct 0.502 -> 0.216, meanLum 44.9 -> 51.7 (bar ~56, readable), blowout 0.0073 (~bar 0.0056) — craft re-scored 7/10, held at gate, no regressions. All wins re-measured same round: core-loop sweet 10/10 + 10 perfects (score 13250, sweetStrain 0.5006), hud-legibility 0 clips, performance mean 1.28ms/40 frames; juice-fx ALSO cleared this round — play capture caught the burst at 442ms < 500ms window with fxParticles 23 >= 20, toast non-empty (previously gap at 658ms). Structure ratio 0.943 -> 0.639 (darker floor now classifies as ground, not structure — critic ruled this intended diorama negative space, not a regression). Harness (shot/analyze/validate) untouched. NEXT GAP (critic): dark field reads as flat crushed void — 21.6% pixels lum<32 vs ~0% in bar; close at darkPct < 0.10 while centerRingContrast > 2.5 and blowout < 0.01 (e.g. graded shadow lift / soft gradient fill on the moss field, not more ambient light that re-browns).
